zobo: Overhead photograph of a tall glass jug of deep red unsweetened zobo with sliced ginger visible, beside a poured glass and a small heap of dried hibiscus leaves on a wooden table. Cold, condensation on the glass. No sugar bowl anywhere. Natural daylight, honest Nigerian home kitchen.
vegetable_soup: Overhead photograph of a bowl of dark green Nigerian vegetable soup thick with ugu and waterleaf, flaked smoked fish visible, beside a small ball of eba on a separate plate. Home kitchen, wooden table, natural light, not restaurant-styled.
okra_soup: Overhead photograph of a bowl of Nigerian okra soup with visible draw, chopped ugu stirred through, a piece of smoked fish on top, beside a small portion of swallow. Wooden table, daylight.
peppered_chicken: Overhead photograph of grilled peppered chicken pieces, skin removed, coated in a dark red pepper sauce, on a plate with sliced onion and a fresh salad. Clearly grilled rather than deep fried. Natural light, Nigerian home kitchen.
ewa_agoyin: Overhead photograph of soft mashed Nigerian beans with a dark, slow-fried onion and pepper sauce spooned over, beside two slices of boiled plantain. Wooden table, natural daylight.
edikaikong: Overhead photograph of a bowl of edikaikong soup, very thick with ugu and waterleaf, pieces of beef and smoked fish visible, palm oil rich but not swimming. Nigerian home kitchen, daylight.
brown_jollof: Overhead photograph of a plate of Nigerian jollof rice made with brown rice, visibly darker and nuttier than white jollof, with a piece of grilled chicken and a fresh tomato and cucumber salad beside it. Natural daylight.
chair_stand: Photograph of a Nigerian woman in her forties standing up from a wooden dining chair with her arms crossed over her chest, mid-movement, in an ordinary home living room. Everyday clothes, no gym wear, no equipment.
wall_press: Photograph of a Nigerian man in his fifties doing a press-up against a plain interior wall, hands flat at shoulder height, body in one straight line, ordinary clothes at home.
marching: Photograph of a Nigerian woman marching on the spot in her living room, one knee lifted to hip height, arms swinging, ordinary house clothes. Natural light, nothing that looks like a gym.
waist_measure: Close photograph of a Nigerian woman measuring her own waist at the navel with a yellow tailor's tape measure, standing, wearing a fitted vest. Only the torso and hands in frame. Natural daylight, plain wall behind.
